description: This file defines an abstract test runner class for transaction concurrency tests using xUnit in the Orleans framework. It overrides test methods to run specific transaction scenarios with different grain states, skipping some tests due to known issues.

classes.name: TransactionConcurrencyTestRunnerxUnit
classes.description: An abstract class extending TransactionConcurrencyTestRunner, providing xUnit-specific test method overrides for transaction concurrency scenarios.

methods.name: TransactionConcurrencyTestRunnerxUnit
methods.description: Constructor initializing the test runner with grain factory and output helper.

methods.name: SingleSharedGrainTest
methods.description: Runs a test where two transactions share a single grain, with specific grain states.

methods.name: TransactionChainTest
methods.description: Runs a test involving a chain of dependent transactions.

methods.name: TransactionTreeTest
methods.description: Runs a test where a single transaction depends on two other transactions involving different grains.
